headline: US stocks drop to their worst day since July as inflation worsens - myMotherLode.com
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.1% on Wednesday, its fifth loss in six days, while the Nasdaq sank 1.9% after a report showed inflation accelerated last month.
why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.
